author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Charlie Cox maybe known more for his work in the MCU than anything else, but his role in last year's mega hit video game Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 certainly left an impression on players. Cox has a new game role lined up, and though he won't say what it is, he does say that it's far more involved than his work in Clair Obscur (for which he provided voice work, but not motion capture). In other news, Xbox's Quick Resume feature is getting an update, allowing you to turn it off for games that require an internet connection. And finally, John Carpenter has listed off his favorite video games of all time, and there's a respectable mix of 16-bit retro titles alongside newer hits.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Daredevil's Charlie Cox Is Working On a New Video Game - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
After months of waiting and an endless deluge of rumors and leaks, Sony and Marvel have finally released the first official trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Tom Holland’s Peter Parker is back in action, and with his return comes a whole new era for the MCU.

The trailer shows off some of the new faces joining the fray in Holland’s fourth Spider-Man movie, all the while raising some big questions about the plot. What’s up with Peter’s powers? How do Hulk and the Punisher fit in? And, perhaps most of all, who the heck is Sadie Sink playing? Let’s break down all the key players in this new trailer and what we do and don’t know about Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is directed by  Destin Daniel Cretton and stars Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, Michael Mando, and Mark Ruffalo. The film hits theaters on July 31, 2026.

#IGN #SpiderMan #Marvel
title: Who Is Sadie Sink Playing? - The Big Questions From the Spider-Man: Brand New Day Trailer

description:
Watch as Bronco (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Sidney (Henry Cavill) give a mission briefing in this clip from the upcoming action movie, In The Grey. In The Grey also stars Eiza González, Kristofer Hivju, Emmett J. Scanlan, Jason Wong, Michael Vu, with Fisher Stevens, with Rosamund Pike, and Carlos Bardem.

In The Grey follows a covert team of elite operatives who live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets much worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

In The Grey is produced by John Friedberg, p.g.a, Dave Caplan, Guy Ritchie, and Ivan Atkinson.

In The Grey, written and directed by Guy Ritchie, opens in theaters on May 15, 2026.
title: In The Grey - Official 'Steal Every Inch' Clip (2026) Jake Gyllenhaal, Henry Cavill, Eiza González

author: IGN
description:
Without Nintendo’s Game Boy Link Cable, Pokemon would have never sold hundreds of millions of video games, printed tens of billions of trading cards, and had hundreds of millions of people play Pokemon Go. Pikachu is a ubiquitous part of pop culture, conquering everything from anime to high art. But how exactly did Nintendo’s failing peripheral lead to the creation of one of gaming’s most iconic brands, helping it stand the test of time over 30 years later? This is the story of how A Failing Nintendo Accessory Spawned Pokemon’s $100 Billion Empire.

#ign #gaming
title: IGN Legacies - How A Failing Nintendo Accessory Spawned the $100 Billion Pokemon Empire

Check out the latest Hunt: Showdown 1896 trailer to see gameplay for the Devil's Trail in-game event, which introduces game-changing scouting and tracking mechanics, a new Battle Pass with many rewards, a new fire-spitting monster, and improvements. The Devil's Trail event is available now alongside the launch of Update 2.7 on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Game Pass, and Xbox Series X/S.

Devil's Trail offers a unique tactical twist to the world of Hunt: Showdown 1896, making information the most valuable currency in the bayou and the Colorado mountains. Supply Points, Extraction Points, and new Event-exclusive Burned Convoy locations are now hidden at Mission start. Players must actively uncover them using Scout Towers scattered across the map, which contain interactive Scouting Maps that reveal hidden locations, new Tarot Cards, custom ammunition, and Traits.

description:
Check out the first trailer for the highly anticipated Spider-Man: Brand New Day! It's been four years since Peter Parker (Tom Holland) made the ultimate sacrifice to save the multiverse, and the world has forgotten who he is. His friends Ned Lees (Jacob Batalon) and MJ (Zendaya) have moved on with life, and Peter has fallen into being a full-time Spider-Man. Being New York's full time super-hero protector has Peter rubbing shoulders with Frank Castle, The Punisher (Jon Bernthal), and battling Scorpion (Michael Mando), but with the arrival of a new threat, and Peter's powers evolving, things will never be the same again. 

Starring Tom Holland, Zendaya, Jon Bernthal, Mark Ruffalo, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, and Michael Mando. 

Spider-Man: Brand New Day arrives in cinemas July 31st, 2026!

Check out the Legend of Mushroom x Palworld trailer for this crossover event between the idle RPG, Legend of Mushroom, and the open-word survival crafting game, Palworld. The limited-time event is out now, and celebrates Legend of Mushroom's second anniversary with an in-game carnival.

The crossover event introduces Palworld characters and Pals into Legend of Mushroom, including Chillet, Cattiva, Lamball, Daedream, Grizzbolt, the fearsome Faction Leader Zoe, and more. They will be available as limited-time Pals, Mounts, Costumes, or powerful Support Star Heroes. New gameplay updates will also be available, giving you a chance to build cozy homes for your pals in the Pal Paradise mode, along with collab mounts, Jetragon and Quivern. A new boss battle called Faction Leader Challenge will also be introduced.
